_meta.author: qt314wink
_meta.description: Surreal ethereal dancer — full semantic design document. Every field is explicit and intentional. Maps to the AURELITH / Melodyfire aesthetic vocabulary: organic iridescence, liminal motion, generative texture, and meditative presence.

work_alignment.AURELITH: Marbled liquid texture = AURELITH's computational skin surface system. Iridescent abalone = the nacre shader layer in the GPU material stack.
work_alignment.Melodyfire: Motion + audio-visual synchrony. The dancer is the visual equivalent of Melodyfire's unified creative platform — rhythm made body.
work_alignment.Beats_and_Boxes: Immersive installation reference. Dark swirling void = the room environment. Blooming flowers = reactive particle system triggered by beat drops.
work_alignment.shader_gallery: Zoe Depth + Canny hybrid = the same depth-normal decomposition used in the WebGL shader gallery. These parameters were reverse-engineered from GLSL normal map blending.

base_style: surreal ethereal dancer, intricate marbled wood-grain and iridescent abalone shell textures flowing like liquid across skin and gown, blooming white flowers and petals gently drifting, dark swirling background lines undulating, golden iridescent lighting, hypnotic graceful slow-motion contemporary dance
negative: blurry, deformed, extra limbs, text, watermark, low quality, realistic photo, cartoon, flat, static, overexposed, harsh shadows, distorted proportions, duplicate faces, bad anatomy, plastic skin, neon colors, horror, violence

negative_rationale.blurry: Wan 2.2 can soften temporal edges — explicit prohibition keeps frames sharp
negative_rationale.static: Prevents the model from treating the pose as a frozen image
negative_rationale.neon colors: Preserves the golden-abalone palette; prevents cyberpunk drift
negative_rationale.plastic skin: Forces organic, textured surface rendering over synthetic smoothness

hybrids.name: Liquid Bloom Dance
hybrids.positive: A graceful ethereal dancer slowly animates, body undulating like liquid marble, raised arm stretching languidly, white flowers blooming and petals floating on gentle cosmic wind, swirling patterns rippling across skin, slow orbiting camera with gentle zoom, cinematic surreal masterpiece

semantics.subject: Single female figure, contemporary dancer, arms partially raised
semantics.texture_primary: Marble — white and gold veining, fluid not static, liquid viscosity
semantics.texture_secondary: Petals and organic fiber weave across gown surface
semantics.background: Deep dark void, soft swirling ink lines at 20% opacity, no hard edges
semantics.lighting: Golden hour chromatic — warm source at 45° upper-left, soft fill from below

body.axis: vertical spine wave, S-curve propagation from hips to raised arm

petals.direction: upward and slightly rightward, 10–15° from vertical
petals.easing: linear with micro ease-in on spawn

camera.easing: ease-in-out cubic for orbit, linear for zoom
camera.timing_cue: orbit begins at 0.5s, reaches midpoint at duration/2

timing.motion_start: 0.3s — body begins undulation after brief hold
timing.camera_peak: 4.5s — orbit at furthest point, zoom at 1.06x

quality.detail_level: ultra — skin texture, petal veining, marble grain all resolved
quality.temporal_consistency: high — use SparseCtrl 0.75 to anchor pose across frames
quality.color_depth: wide gamut — golden ambers, cool marble whites, deep void blacks

hybrids.meaning: Transformation without rupture. The body as a surface that holds multiple natures simultaneously — stone and water, still and moving. The raised arm is not a gesture of triumph but of becoming.
hybrids.intent: Establish the visual language of the series: slow, deliberate, textured motion that rewards close attention. The viewer should feel they are watching something that cannot be paused — an organism mid-metamorphosis.
hybrids.inspiration: Ana Mendieta's earth-body works, Hiroshi Sugimoto's long-exposure seascapes, AURELITH's nacre material shader (the abalone surface is the computational skin made painterly).
takeaways: Lead piece — sets the tonal and textural baseline for the entire series
Marble undulation is the signature motion — preserve across all hybrids
Petal timing at 1.5s bloom cue is emotionally resonant — replicate in other hybrids

hybrids.name: Abalone Dreamscape
hybrids.positive: Dreamlike figure in marbled iridescent textures shimmering with blue-green nacre, elegant pose with head tilted back, flowers adorning body, background swirls flowing in harmony, soft glowing highlights, highly detailed artistic slow motion

semantics.subject: Single female figure, head tilted back 30–40°, neck extended, arms relaxed downward with slight outward float
semantics.texture_primary: Abalone nacre — blue-green-purple iridescent shift, micro-layered light interference pattern
semantics.texture_secondary: White flowers integrated into gown surface as structural elements, not floating
semantics.background: Deep teal-to-black gradient swirl, softer and more diffuse than hybrid_01
semantics.lighting: Cool backlighting from upper-right, creating halo effect at shoulder and neck edges

body.easing: sinusoidal — smooth oscillation, no hold at endpoints

nacre_shimmer.behavior: Color hue rotates 30° (blue → green → purple) across duration as lighting angle shifts
nacre_shimmer.trigger: driven by camera angle change, not body motion

camera.movement: static with micro-float (0.3° drift, breathing feel)
camera.height: slightly below eye level, 10° upward tilt — emphasizes neck extension
camera.timing_cue: camera begins micro-float at 0s, constant throughout

timing.sway_start: 0s — body begins sway immediately, no hold

quality.detail_level: ultra — nacre micro-layering must be visible at 720P
quality.temporal_consistency: very high — iridescence shift must be smooth, no flicker
quality.color_depth: cool spectrum — teal, cobalt, purple, near-black void

hybrids.meaning: Surrender and receptivity. The tilted-back head is a posture of yielding — to light, to gravity, to the gaze. The nacre skin makes her simultaneously precious object and living being.
hybrids.intent: Create the coolest, most contemplative piece in the series. Contrast to hybrid_01's warm gold. This is the moon piece to its sun.
hybrids.inspiration: James Turrell's light installations, Yayoi Kusama's Infinity Rooms, the iridescence shader in the AURELITH nacre layer (blue-green-purple angular shift at 0.5 cycles per clip).
takeaways: Nacre shimmer driven by camera angle is the key technical innovation — achieve via ControlNet depth shift
Cool palette is intentional counterpoint to hybrid_01 warmth
Static camera creates meditation-like stillness — resist urge to add orbit

hybrids.name: Golden Flow Motion
hybrids.positive: Golden luminous skin with flowing wood-grain patterns, delicate white blooms fluttering, fluid dance movement like underwater silk, dark abstract swirling void background, elegant cinematic lighting shifts, slow graceful motion

semantics.subject: Dancer in mid-movement, arms extended laterally, slight forward lean, fabric billowing
semantics.texture_primary: Wood grain — warm amber-gold, flowing directionally aligned with body motion vector
semantics.texture_secondary: Silk fabric — translucent, trailing behind motion with 0.3s physics delay
semantics.background: Absolute void black with faint wood-grain echo lines, barely perceptible at 10% opacity
semantics.lighting: Three-point cinematic: warm key at 30° upper-left, cool fill at 180°, subtle gold rim from below

body.axis: full-body, initiated at core, propagating outward to fingertips
body.speed: 0.35× realtime with variable acceleration — faster at joint initiations
body.amplitude: large — full arm extension to 160° spread
body.easing: fluid easing — ease-out on extension (like water drag), ease-in on retraction

fabric.easing: exponential decay oscillation after peak extension

lighting_shift.direction: key light rotates 15° over full duration (left → slightly left-center)
lighting_shift.effect: warm gold surface highlights shift across wood-grain texture, revealing grain direction
lighting_shift.speed: imperceptibly slow — viewer feels warmth change, doesn't see it

camera.movement: very slow dolly forward + slight tilt up
camera.easing: linear ease-in — almost imperceptible start, building presence
camera.timing_cue: dolly begins at 1.0s, viewer barely notices until 4.0s

timing.motion_start: 0s — dancer already in motion from first frame
timing.lighting_peak: 4.0s — warmest golden moment, maximum grain visibility

quality.detail_level: ultra — wood grain directionality and lighting interaction must read at full resolution
quality.temporal_consistency: high — fabric trail requires frame coherence
quality.color_depth: warm spectrum — amber, gold, warm white blooms against pure black

hybrids.meaning: Momentum as identity. The body in motion is more itself than the body at rest. Wood grain as skin inverts the natural order — organic material becomes the living thing, and living tissue becomes structured pattern.
hybrids.intent: The most kinetic piece — shows the dancer as force rather than form. The void background ensures nothing competes with the body's directional energy.
hybrids.inspiration: Loïe Fuller's silk dance, computational fluid dynamics visualizations, the directional wood-grain shader from AURELITH's surface material system.
takeaways: Higher AnimateDiff scale (1.1) needed for fabric trailing — don't reduce
Lighting sweep is subtle but critical — it's what makes wood grain read as alive
Dolly + tilt combination creates intimacy without cutting — respect the slow reveal

hybrids.name: Nacre Bloom
hybrids.positive: Figure dissolving into cascading nacre and mother-of-pearl light, blooming white roses emerging from swirling dark ink, iridescent highlights fracturing like prism across organic form, time-lapse bloom meets slow liquid pour

semantics.subject: Figure in transition between solid and liquid state — upper body defined, lower body dissolving into light
semantics.texture_primary: Mother-of-pearl — layered interference, soft rainbow diffraction bands, semi-transparent
semantics.texture_secondary: Dark ink fluid — swirling upward from lower frame, enveloping and releasing
semantics.background: Near-black with dark ink bloom spreading from 60% screen height downward, fading to pure black at bottom
semantics.lighting: Diffuse light source from within figure — self-luminous, no external key light, edges dissolve into background

body.type: dissolution — lower half loses definition progressively
body.direction: upward dissolution from feet to hip over 4 seconds
body.speed: extremely slow — 0.1× realtime for dissolution edge

roses.speed: 0.4× realtime — faster than other floral elements in series
roses.count: 3–5 roses in frame simultaneously at peak
roses.easing: ease-out — rapid open then slow final petal spread

prism_fracture.colors: spectral — violet, cyan, gold bands, 1–3px width
prism_fracture.trigger: appears on body edges where light meets dissolution boundary

camera.timing_cue: locked camera forces viewer to watch dissolution rather than follow movement

timing.prism_onset: 2.0s — fracture begins as dissolution crosses hip line

quality.detail_level: ultra — prism fracture bands must be sharp at 1px, roses must show petal venation
quality.temporal_consistency: medium — intentional dissolution allows some frame-to-frame softness
quality.color_depth: full spectrum during prism phase — otherwise cool pearl and near-black

hybrids.meaning: The self as temporary coherence. Identity is a pattern that holds for a while, then releases. The roses bloom as the body dissolves — beauty intensifies as form departs.
hybrids.intent: The conceptual anchor of the series. More abstract than the other hybrids, intended as the emotional climax. Should feel inevitable, not sad — dissolution as completion.
hybrids.inspiration: Bill Viola's video installations (particularly The Greeting and Fire Woman), the nacre dissolution effect from Melodyfire's visualizer, Buddhist concept of anatta (non-self).
takeaways: Lower SparseCtrl (0.60) is deliberate — less pose anchoring lets the dissolution read naturally
Locked camera is non-negotiable — any movement would undercut the stillness of watching something disappear
Three rose bloom staggers (0.8s apart) create emotional rhythm — this is the heartbeat of the piece

hybrids.name: Void Dancer
hybrids.positive: Luminous figure suspended in deep cosmic void, marbled veins of gold and jade threading through translucent skin, flowers orbiting in slow gravitational drift, dark nebula swirls as fabric folds, cinematic wide then close pull

semantics.subject: Dancer suspended weightless, no ground contact implied, centered in frame with negative space dominant
semantics.texture_primary: Translucent skin with gold-jade marble vein threading — skin reads as semi-transparent, veins glow faintly
semantics.texture_secondary: Nebula-like fabric folds — dark with faint bioluminescent edge highlighting
semantics.background: Deep space black, subtle nebula bloom in upper-right quadrant at 15% opacity, no horizon line
semantics.lighting: Internal luminescence from within figure — cold white-gold, radiates outward 2–4px soft glow

body.axis: all three axes, extremely slow — like ISS drift
body.amplitude: 3–5° total rotation per axis over full duration

flowers.orbit_radius: 15–25% of frame width from figure center
flowers.speed: 0.08× realtime — slower than all other floral elements in series
flowers.plane: slightly tilted orbital plane, not flat

camera.movement: wide pullback then slow push-in — reveal arc
camera.start_focal: 35mm equivalent — establishes cosmic scale and isolation
camera.end_focal: 85mm equivalent — closes in to intimate portrait by end
camera.zoom_easing: ease-in-out cubic, primary motion of the clip
camera.timing: wide at 0s, begins pull-in at 2.5s, reaches portrait frame at 6.0s

nebula_swirl.speed: 0.03× realtime — barely perceptible as motion, reads as ambient atmosphere

camera.timing_cue: The camera is the protagonist of this clip — its journey from isolation to intimacy IS the meaning

timing.hold_intimate: 6.0s → 8.0s — 2 second hold at portrait focal length
timing.fade_out: none — hard cut at 8.0s — the intimacy should feel sudden

quality.detail_level: ultra — jade vein translucency must read at portrait focal length
quality.temporal_consistency: very high — the slow camera move requires frame-level smoothness
quality.color_depth: cold spectrum — jade green, cold gold, near-white luminescence, pure black void

hybrids.meaning: Solitude as freedom. The void is not loneliness but sovereignty — infinite negative space as evidence of self-possession. The camera's approach is the viewer earning intimacy rather than being given it.
hybrids.intent: The closing piece of the series. After dissolution in hybrid_04, this is rebirth in weightlessness. Should feel earned, quiet, and vast.
hybrids.inspiration: Kubrick's star gate sequence, Agnes Martin's grid paintings (emptiness as fullness), the cosmic shader environments built for Beats & Boxes installations.
takeaways: The 2s hard hold at portrait focal length at the end is the most important timing decision in the series
Maximum Zoe Depth (1.0) and SparseCtrl (0.80) anchors the figure firmly during the long camera move
Camera movement IS the narrative arc — do not add competing body movements

extra_modifiers: subtle glowing particles, delicate light rays
soft volumetric god rays, gentle wind flow
more dynamic petal movement, dreamlike atmosphere
deep cinematic bokeh, luminous rim light
gossamer light threads, slow motion flower bloom
pearl dust motes suspended in still air
micro-caustic light patterns on skin surface
refracted rainbow film on water-surface texture

sequence.role: Opening — establishes the visual language and warmth

series_arc.motion_arc: undulation → sway → full-body flow → dissolution → weightless float
series_arc.camera_arc: slow orbit → static → dolly → locked → wide-to-portrait
series_arc.overall_meaning: A body moving through states of being: present and textured → reflective → forceful → dissolving → transcendent. The series maps the interior journey of creative work itself — from first mark to release.
